name: Elias Weyne
title: Shield Specialist
text: In combats you start with a Tactical action: once per damage event, reduce total hits by 1 (minimum 0), after other defences.

name: Hesta Kraw
title: Bounty Hunter
text: In combats you start with Tactical: whenever a rival discards a component in this combat, gain 1 resource (any type) to the faction pool.

name: Soren Krell
title: Weapons Officer
text: +1 to attack rolls for every weapon on this ship (stacks with other Weapons Officers and accuracy gear).

name: Aris Thorne
title: Expert Marksman
text: When a rival loses a component in combat with you, split their installed components into two piles; you choose a pile and they lose a random component from it.

name: Luciana Zavaleta
title: Salvage Expert
text: When this ship loses a component in combat, gain 2 resources (your choice) to the faction pool (voluntary discards do not count).

name: Mateo Belgrano
title: Quartermaster
text: On each upgrade for this ship, remove 1 resource of your choice from the cost (minimum 0; several Quartermasters stack).

name: Bramm Zekk
title: Profit-Chaser
text: +1 speed while this ship's cargo hold is full.

name: Caspian Frey
title: Black Marketeer
text: On Trade: deliver one resource to a planet that does not demand it; it goes to the pool with no price or market effect.

name: Syra Nelos
title: Trade Expert
text: Once per Trade action: when delivering demand, gain 1 extra resource to the pool (must be one you are trading).

name: Priya Chaudhary
title: Xeno Scientist
text: When drawing enemy cards, draw 2 cards, choose 1 and return the other to the bottom of the deck.

name: Sari Dewi
title: Comms Specialist
text: On Interact: use the Interact effect of an adjacent revealed hex, even if opposing ships are there (includes Nexuses).

name: Kora Nyx
title: Void Scout
text: After this ship completes a Move action, take one free Interact at the destination (once per Move; normal Interact rules apply).

name: Hiroshi Kang
title: Long-range Sensor Specialist
text: Before a Move action, peek at two unrevealed adjacent tiles.

name: Orin Tals
title: Warp Engineer
text: Once per Move action, move along a warp link that is gated on only one side (MAP-7).
